loadDefaults.help: Adds any missing default waiver, intake and agreement forms and marketing automations in the selected language. Untouched defaults are switched to that language; anything your team has edited is left as is. This also happens automatically when you change the default language above — use the button if something did not load.
loadDefaults.autoReseedNotice: Default forms & automations are being switched to {{language}} automatically. If anything is still missing in a moment, use this button.
loadDefaults.successDescription: {{created}} created, {{replaced}} switched to {{language}}, {{customized}} skipped because they were customized.
loadDefaults.nothingToDoDescription: Your forms and automations are already in {{language}}, or have been customized by your team.
loadDefaults.errorDescription: Something went wrong while loading the default forms. Please try again.
